children: Thoma Bravo-owned Proofpoint is in talks to buy cybersecurity firm Varonis Systems
, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Wednesday.
Thoma Bravo declined a request for comment, while Proofpoint and Varonis did not immediately respond.
Shares of Varonis, which has a market value of about $5 billion, were up over 10%.
